title: Local étale representatives for finite-level Isom sections
statement: Under the bounded finite-lisse, fixed-realization comparison, and local model hypotheses of the finite-level descent theorem, every geometric point of the etale base has an etale neighbourhood carrying an actual derived isomorphism from the normalized constant model to the supplied etale complex.

source.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z, 09B1 and 09BV, local comparison and Isom presheaf sections.

proof.text: Obtain the pointwise pro-etale derived Isom sections from the finite-level comparison and model sieve. Extract the lower bound a from hDbounded; DerivedCategory.isGE_iff gives D.IsGE a, hence D belongs to the bounded-below subcategory. Apply the repaired etale representative theorem with that bound. Its conclusion is the original finite-level conclusion with no new hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09B1, lemma-compare-derived; bounded-below derived comparison, together with localization and exact pullback.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_level_etale_local_isomorphisms
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (U : Y.ProEt) (n : ℕ)
    (N : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))))
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)))
    (D : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))))
    (hDbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D))
    (hDlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D))
    (hcomparison : Nonempty ((lisseTowerFixedRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) U.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj D) ≅
        (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N))
    (hmodels : ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧
      ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w →
        Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
          (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
            ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)) :
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left),
      ∃ (V : U.left.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj V),
        Nonempty ((localIsomorphismRestriction U.left
          (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n) V).obj
            ((normalizationConstant U.left.smallEtaleTopology).obj E) ≅
          (localIsomorphismRestriction U.left
            (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n) V).obj D)
